create.name: William Peters
create.bio:
William Peters founded the Shared Crossing Project, which studies and teaches about shared death experiences: accounts from relatives, friends and carers who report taking part in some way in a dying person's passage beyond this life. His interest began in 2000 during a spell as a volunteer at a San Francisco Zen hospice, where he had such an experience at a patient's bedside; he has also described two near-death experiences of his own. He studied at UC Berkeley and at Harvard, and he directs the project's research arm, which gathers first-hand stories and sorts them into a set of recognisable types.

His teaching aims to help people approach the end of life with less fear and more connection, for themselves and for those they love. He offers self-paced online courses through the project, including an introduction to shared crossings recorded with Raymond Moody, alongside a monthly online sharing circle, talks and filmed conversations with figures such as Eben Alexander. His book At Heaven's Door, published by Simon & Schuster in 2022, sets out the stories and patterns his team has collected and what they suggest about living and dying well. He lives and works in Santa Barbara, California, and a documentary on the subject is in production.

books.title: At Heaven's Door: What Shared Journeys to the Afterlife Teach About Dying Well and Living Better
books.author: William Peters
books.description: Peters draws on two decades of collected first-hand accounts to describe how the living sometimes accompany the dying at the threshold of death. He groups the stories into common patterns and considers what they suggest about preparing for death and living more fully.

courses.title: The Shared Crossing Pathway: Accompanying Loved Ones Through a Beautiful End of Life
courses.description: A twelve-module self-paced online course in which Peters teaches his methods for preparing yourself and those close to you for a conscious, connected end of life. It also covers how a shared crossing might unfold and how to stay open to one.

courses.title: The Shared Death Experience: Transformational Journeys of Life and Love Beyond Death
courses.description: A seven-module self-study course that looks closely at the features of shared death experiences through recorded stories and the project's research. Students learn the main types Peters has described and what they may mean for the bereaved.

courses.title: A Glimpse Beyond the Threshold: Shared Death Experiences
courses.description: A six-part introductory course on shared death experiences, taught by Peters with Raymond Moody, who first named the phenomenon. It includes three recorded question-and-answer sessions with the two of them.

free_resources.title: SDE Sharing Group
free_resources.description: A free monthly online circle run by the Shared Crossing research team for people who have had a shared death experience or are curious about them. Members share accounts and hear others' stories on Zoom.
